utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Well, let's start by Mr. Fila. Is there anything you want to raise in this Status Conference?

utterances.speaker: MR. FILA
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, no. Let me just repeat my satisfaction and say that I regret that we will not see each other again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: We will see each other at the delivery of the judgement. Mr. Simic. MR. J. SIMIC: [Interpretation] We have no particular matters to raise either. We're just awaiting the judgement. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. STOJANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. My client would like to address a few words to you, with your permission, and I would also give an explanation if necessary. If you could allow him to speak, but it is not really linked to the actual content of the proceedings. I would be grateful.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Is it -- is it linked to the detention?

utterances.speaker: MR. STOJANOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I don't really know. He's telling me it is not. I believe that it has to do with the decision of this Chamber. I don't remember exactly who made this decision. And that was instructions to the Registry. And I think it has to do with the Defence, and that is the reason why my client would like to say something. I think that he was the one who conducted this procedure. He was the one who took these -- the initiative for these administrative matters, so I would like him to be able to explain.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Mr. Zigic, is this related to the decision of the Registrar still pending on the payment of fees? THE APPELLANT ZIGIC: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: We consulted with the Registry before the Status Conference and they promised to issue a decision soon. I don't know if there's anything in particular you want to add. THE APPELLANT ZIGIC: [Interpretation] In that case, no. I just wanted to tell you that I am under psychological pressure. Since the Registry has not been paying my Defence counsel, the existence of my family is in question. I have to sell the only property I have; that is, my apartment, to be able to pay the enormous bills of Mr. Stojanovic. These are very high amounts which I'm unable to pay, and I'm under great pressure. And the Registry has still not made a decision, and I am very worried about it. But in any event, if you have consulted with the Registry and if the decision will be made soon, I have nothing else to add except to appeal for expediency. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you very much, Mr. Zigic. After the Status Conference, I will again contact the Registry and ask if there is a date they can promise the decision to be issued. And as to the judgement, you heard the Presiding Judge promising the judgement first as soon as possible, and then saying something about autumn. So it should be in this year. Does any of the parties want to add something?

utterances.speaker: MS. BRADY
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. The Prosecution has nothing further to add.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE WEINBERG DE ROCA
utterances.text: Thank you. Then we will miss each other after having seen so much of us the last few days, and this Status Conference is adjourned.
